Hey you!

That's 'cos I race with the speed of a 
wolf!

I'm counting on you.

Hi!
How are you?
Nice day today.
I'm going to be in the front with you.
How about adding me to the team, 
replacing your current teammate?

This is Grandpa Tal's cave.
He's rolling barrels as usual.

Oh!

Hello.
Have you seen our owner?

Ho!
Welcome!

Welcome.

Ah!
Who are you?
Did you come to save me?!
I was kidnapped by the owner of 
Echigoya!

He wanted me to marry the evil police 
chief!
Thank you so much for saving me!
I want to thank you.
Please take this.

Hello.
This is the Fortune Telling Room.

Oh, where did my Otomi go?
Oh, please help me!
I hope she's safe.

Hey!
How are you?

Hey!
You came again!
You must be curious.
My grandpa said he got the propeller in a 
building under the sea, near a snow 
capped mountain.
Anyway, you're about the only one who 
visits me.
I'm lonely.

Hey!
I was just practising.

Hello!
Welcome!
Hey!
It's you!

Hehehe!
Good to see you!

Hey you.
Are you asking me?

your team!
Didn't you?

can I help you?

Hey!

Oh!

I can't get myself to like the toy gun.

Oh, welcome.


Are you aware of a clover shaped 
junction located to the east of 
Sandpolis?
Someone there likes to challenge people.
Just recently I challenged him, but I 
couldn't beat him.
Ha, ha, ha!
But someone like you would be a good 
match.
Where is it?
It's located at the very first entrance to 
the highway.
Yes, near Fuji City.
There, you can ask a person named 
Natsuo about it.
Good luck!

Busy!
Busy!

can you deliver it?

How's it going?

Hey!
Who are you?
Don't be staring at me!

Oh, it's only you...
I thought it was someone else.
Hehehe...

Welcome!
I don't really like this job, but you'd be 
good at it.
Will you work part-time?

Bon jour!
How are you?
I'm fine and racing well.
You should add someone like me to your 
team.
Hey!
How about me?

Hi!
What's up?
You're a racer?
I see.
I consider myself pretty good.
How about putting me on your team?

Hehehe.
You're worried, right?
Worried about racing?
If you add me to your team, your troubles 
will be over.
So, how about adding me?

You!

If you wish...

will you let me join your team instead of

Lucy races like a wind...la la Lucy is 
fast as an antelope..la Did you hear it?
That's my song.
Just like my song, my driving technique is 
great.

I think you should let me join your team, 
and replace your teammate.
Let's do that!

Brrrrrrrrr!

watch T.V.

What should I eat today?

Hee hee hee hee hee!
